MUSEUM OF THE COLONIAL ATLANTIC

A walk-through exhibition

How did slavery become a system?

Between 1619 and 1740, the status of Africans in British North America shifted from ambiguous to fixed: permanent, hereditary, and defined by race. Walk the galleries, examine the evidence, and see how it happened.
